title: Holdout and species inventory
headline: Clade confirmed: Aves, by Amit on 2026-10-31 ("Sure do AVes", via the hub); re-frozen 14:38:42 UTC with the decision and its cost written into exam.json, roster unchanged since the first freeze at 05:52 UTC, leak check clean after re-freeze. Cost taken knowingly: 13 birds against the builders' minimum of 50 and 8 against 15, so both examined tests read inconclusive; Mammalia would have made 1 of 2 decisive but 3 built tests post hoc. 9 nanopub records drafted (unsigned, unpublished; np check and Delphi lint clean), the clade record now leads with the power finding. Awaiting the key owner for signing and the test registry. Merge conflicts 0.
